prompt_md: Move a 4-disc Tower of Hanoi from one peg to another, one disc at a time and never big on small, but with 4 pegs instead of 3. Fewest moves?
prompt_short: Tower of Hanoi, 4 discs, 4 pegs. Fewest moves?
hint_md: Park the two smallest discs on a spare peg of their own.
explain_intuition_md: With 3 pegs it takes 15 moves, and it's easy to assume the extra peg changes little. Move the 2 smallest discs to a spare peg (3 moves), move the 2 big ones across using the other 3 pegs (3 moves), then bring the small pair back on top (3 moves).
explain_math_md: $$3 + 3 + 3 = 9$$ A full search of all positions confirms nothing shorter exists.
